authority: docs/tier7/ticket-46-model-routing-decision.md. Protected by policy/ in protected-paths.json. A change here moves model_version, a D19 fingerprint field, and the glossary suspends every autonomy grant on a fingerprint change.
notes: The routing key is capability_id, declared in policy/role-bindings.json. Not palette kind: the frozen task specification standard requires the task field `capability` and calls it 'Never a role', and the glossary calls a capability 'Never a job title'. Not task class: that term already names the product's schedulable CriMe class.

`inherit` is forbidden. It defers model_version to a UI dropdown, so a fingerprint would change when someone changes a setting, silently suspending every grant measured on it. Every key resolves to a pinned identity.

The `trivial` class is defined here and is EMPTY at Phase 0. A capability enters it only through measurement, on the autonomy-grant evidence path. Until then every capability routes to a capable model and gpt-5-nano runs nothing.
Alfred passes the model explicitly on every spawn. The vendored ECC autoforge/model-policy.yaml default is never consulted; see loud_default below for what happens if a spawn omits the override.

forbidden.inherit: any unpinned or session-derived model identity

loud_default.reason: The fallback when a spawn omits its explicit override. Set to fail expensively rather than cheaply: a wrong-but-expensive default surfaces the omission on the invoice, while a wrong-but-cheap one hides it until a validator has been running on a trivial model for a month. This is the direction scripts/lint_ci_coverage.py's docstring names — an enumeration drifts silently, in the direction that reads green.

trivial_class.entry_condition: Measured merge rate on the cheap model, on a stated fingerprint, meeting the threshold docs/tier3/autonomy-graduation-policy.md will set. That document is a deliberate stub with evidence 'none'; until it has content, nothing enters this list.
trivial_class.empty_because: No measurement exists of any model against any Alfred capability. An allowlist authored today would rest on nothing — which is how the vendored AutoForge policy arrived at validator: gpt-5-nano, requirements-griller: gpt-5-nano and investigator: gpt-5-nano.

routes.reason: Long-horizon planning and architecture-shaping decisions. The brief's §11 names planning and architecture as Opus work, and a charting error propagates into every ticket the map produces.
Discovery reads and summarizes; it authors no contract and holds no authority.
Requirements grilling. Explicitly on the forbidden list for the cheap model.
Architecture. The most expensive error class available and the one a harness cannot check.
Planning, and it carries the independent critique pass that makes plan auto-approval safe.
Execution against an already-decided plan, under an executable criterion.
Final review. Explicitly on the forbidden list for the cheap model.
Validation authority. The thesis is that the thing checking the work is not the thing doing it, which a trivial model defeats.
